records.prompt:
Draw ONE genuinely new detailed 2D PIXEL-ART BASIC animation atlas of the SAME fictional videogame character as the inspected attached native presentation reference. That reference contains32poses; all16 new drawings must be fresh, never copied cells. No real actor portrait.
LOCKED IDENTITY: Dogmeat, fictional adult GERMAN SHEPHERD DOG from Fallout4(2015). Real natural canine anatomy: elongated muzzle, erect pointed ears, brown/tan fur with BLACK SADDLE, four real canine legs ending in PAWS and claws, hocks and dog elbows, one long bushy tail, no human torso or hands. Keep a simple worn olive cloth neck bandana; REMOVE the old sprite’s huge saddlebags/armor so anatomy is readable. QUADRUPED IN EVERY CELL; never stands as a human, never holds anything. Proportional reference: standing ear-tip height about110px, withers80px, nose-to-rump body length about170px, long tail extends behind within cell. DO NOT force human190px vertical height. Match this one canine scale across every row.
EXACT GRID: FOUR COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS=16 distinct complete poses, square1024x1024 true transparent alpha, equal256pxcells. All heads, arms, props, tools, muzzles, paws and tails inside each cell with at least24px transparent gutters. No text, label, panel, gridline, scene, floor, watermark or opponent. Combat faces RIGHT. Keep QUADRUPED natural proportions: ear-tip height about110px/withers80px/body length170px plus tail. No forced190px human height; all four canine limbs in every cell, no hands/weapon. ONE consistent source-wide canine scale, crouches stay shorter.
ROW1 IDLE:4 distinct four-paw alert weight shifts, ear/head movement and natural canine stance. Never translate/repeat an unchanged pose.
ROW2 RUN:4 genuine canine locomotion phases with four real legs: front reach/back push, gathered suspension, opposite reach, landing; natural dog spine and tail. No biped sprint or human arms.
ROW3 ATTACK/ACTION: Four actual canine bite poses: quadruped low crouch, forward snap with natural open jaw, paws braced jaw closing on EMPTY AIR, return to four-paw guard. Every cell has exactly four canine limbs and one tail; no weapon/hand, no magical slash trail.
ROW4 HIT:4 new non-graphic canine recoil poses: shoulders flinch, low four-paw stagger, defensive dog crouch, stable four-paw recovery. Exactly four canine limbs and one tail, no injury, blood, magical stars, weapon or upright humanoid.
Exactly4 full bodies per row, all4 rows present,16different new native poses. Tiny physical firing flash only where the prescribed basic action is a real shot; support characters show no weapon/discharge, no shield bubble or magic. Keep generous transparent margins; muzzle recovery is empty, no captured ball/tool magic in non-prescribed rows.
